recommendation.summary: Report baseline on score-available subset, evaluate model on same subset for head-to-head comparison
rationale: The -1 sentinel (not computable) indicates missing data, not a score of -1
SAPS-I: 47 rows (2.65%) have -1, with 27.7% mortality vs 14.1% for available
SOFA: 42 rows (2.37%) have -1, with 26.2% mortality vs 14.1% for available
Keeping -1 as numeric inverts risk (high-risk patients scored as lowest risk)
Excluding -1 rows recovers 0.0243 AUROC and 0.0035 AUPRC for SAPS-I
Excluding -1 rows recovers 0.0190 AUROC and 0.0047 AUPRC for SOFA
Median replacement is better than keeping -1 but still biases comparison toward the model

reporting_protocol.for_clinical_baselines: Report AUROC/AUPRC on score-available subset only (SAPS-I n=1728, SOFA n=1733)
reporting_protocol.for_ml_model_comparison: Evaluate model on same score-available subset for fair head-to-head comparison
reporting_protocol.for_ml_model_full_test: Also report model performance on full test set (n=1775) with clear denominator
reporting_protocol.always_specify: Always name the denominator (n=1728 for SAPS-I subset, n=1733 for SOFA subset, n=1775 for full test)
